context: A married couple shares an evening anecdote
purpose: Teach: 犯し/払わ/許す/かわいそう/始末/はずれ/目立っ/見かける

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、今日駅前で変な人を見かけるの、最近多くない？
lines.en: Hey, lately I keep spotting strange people near the station, don't you think?
lines.style: Casual evening chat, slightly worried wifely tone

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、町のはずれにも怪しい男が立っててさ、ちょっと目立ってたよ。
lines.en: Yeah, there was a suspicious man standing at the edge of town too, kind of stood out.
lines.style: Relaxed husband recounting his day, mildly amused tone

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 怖いわね。罪を犯した人だったらどうするの？
lines.en: That's scary. What if he was someone who committed a crime?
lines.style: Concerned wife, voice rising slightly with anxiety

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いやいや、ただの酔っぱらいだよ。代金も払わないで店から追い出されたらしい。
lines.en: No no, just a drunk. Apparently he got kicked out of a shop for not paying.
lines.style: Reassuring, chuckling lightly while sipping tea calmly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あらまあ、それはちょっとかわいそうね。お店の人も始末に困ったでしょうね。
lines.en: Oh my, that's a little pitiful. The shop staff must have been at their wit's end too.
lines.style: Sympathetic and sighing softly with motherly compassion showing

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん、でも店主は怒らず許すって言ってたらしいよ。優しい人だね。
lines.en: Yeah, but I heard the owner said he wouldn't be angry and would forgive him. Kind person.
lines.style: Warm and admiring tone, nodding thoughtfully while speaking

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いい話ね。あなたの予想がはずれて、ほっとしたわ。
lines.en: What a nice story. I'm relieved your prediction turned out wrong.
lines.style: Smiling with gentle laugh, comfortable closeness between them

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: だろ？世の中まだ捨てたもんじゃないよ。
lines.en: Right? The world's not such a bad place after all.
lines.style: Content with quiet smile, settling back into the sofa
